description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from averiecooks.com. It uses 'request' for HTTP requests and 'cheerio' for HTML parsing, and exports a function that returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object.

methods.name: averieCooks
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, parses the HTML to extract recipe details, and returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object.
